02 — Tourism Card Measurement & Reporting

Turn the tourism card into
a channel we can measure.

  • Track scans, offer claims and referral traffic business by business
  • Separate visitor spending from resident spending
  • Report real numbers back to each participating business

Every scan also grows the email list — the same list the weekly round-up is sent to. Measurement here feeds everything else.

03 — Ardmore Event Promotion

04 — Chamber Member Learning Library

On-demand training every
member can actually use.

Members see tremendous individual benefit from a short list of basics. The library teaches the 20% of digital marketing that drives 80% of the results — the 80/20 rule, applied business by business:

Google Business ProfileBuild it, keep it current
Reviews & reputationAsk, respond, repeat
Social media basicsWhat to post, and how often
A website that gets foundPractical SEO, no jargon
AI that saves timeAutomate the routine parts
Own your audienceEmail list fundamentals
  • A digital readiness score for every member business
  • Re-scored quarterly, so improvement is visible and reportable

06 — Explore Ardmore, Rebuilt

The visitor site isn’t earning
what the brand has built.

  • The events calendar greets visitors with sixteen copies of the same Mahjong Mondays listing on a single day
  • Business photos are blurry and low-resolution — a first impression that undersells real places
  • The directory is a bare list that gives no reason to click through
  • The itineraries section — the heart of a visitor site — holds two articles

Rebuild exploreardmore.com on the Ardmore Means More brand — fed by the content engine, the weekly events round-up and the directory work already in this program, so it stays current without anyone tending it by hand.

Observations from exploreardmore.com, September 3, 2026.

Ardmore Chamber of Commerce

Implementation

Nothing pauses.

Phase 01
Days 1–30
Setup, without a gap in publishing

Content continues uninterrupted while the CRM and automation platform are stood up, the measurement framework and dashboard are built, the training library is first recorded, and the job collection pipeline goes in. Pre-production on the first shoot.

Phase 02
Days 31–90
Activation

Property and workforce content in rotation. First What’s Happening emails out. Offer tracking running. First monthly dashboard delivered. Shoot one executed. Training library published with its first scorecard run, and the weekly hiring email in production.

Phase 03
Ongoing
Growth & optimization

Shoots two and three. Monthly reporting and optimization. Quarterly library additions and scorecard re-runs. Weekly hiring collection. Per-business engagement data delivered into the Annual Visibility Report and the Chamber rollup.
